unresolvedReferences.description: The Chinese repeats the son's name as 子 博宣子博宣. The English reads it once as Zhao Bozhuan and supplies the surname Zhao, which the Chinese does not write.
The Chinese writes the name twice, 李紓李紓. The English reads it once as Li Shu and adds the courtesy name Zhongshu from 字仲舒.

The biography says Yu Gongyi's stepmother did not accept him. The edict in s0168 broadens this to parents (父母). The edict is not used as evidence for who rejected him, and no separate parent is created from that conflicting wording.
李汧公 is Duke of Qian. The packet English says Duke of Fen. External biographies identify him as Li Mian; that personal name is not in this chapter and is not recorded.
The Chinese says 子 溫溫, doubling 溫. It is one person, Lü Wen, not two. The literal repeats Wen and is repaired; the Chinese duplication is left as a textual discrepancy.
The Chinese repeats 恭、儉 in 子 恭、儉恭、儉. Gong and Jian are still the two sons named in s0190, not four people. The literal repeats them and is repaired.
知制詔 uses 詔 where the office title is normally 知制誥. The English already reads it as drafter of edicts.

丘明 is named without the surname 左. The idiomatic English says Zuo Qiuming; that surname is external. 張始興 is the subject of a eulogy; identifying him as Zhang Jiuling, who died in AD 740, is external and is not written into the name.

Cai Tingyu reports Zheng Yunkui, who is dismissed to recording secretary in Mozhou (莫州錄事參軍). The preceding biography says Zhu Ci himself, angry on reaching the capital, demoted him to aide in Mozhou (莫州參軍). The two units disagree on the agent and the title. s0223 is not used as evidence for either.
三年 names no reign. It is left between Zhu Tao's rebellion and the Yuanhe 1 appointment, AD 783-806, and is not converted to Jianzhong 3 or Zhenyuan 3.
徐、趙、劉、李 are surnames. Read in biography order they are Xu Hao, Zhao Juan, Liu Taizhen, and Li Shu. Li Yi is not this 李; he is named in full in s0261.
邵、于、呂、鄭 are surnames. Read in biography order they are Shao Yue, Yu Shao, Lü Wei, and Zheng Yunkui. Yu Gongyi was named in full in s0261, so 于 is not him.
